text:
DNS::len
Description
This iRules command returns the dns packet message length.
Note
: This command requires the DNS Profile, which is only enabled
as part of GTM or the DNS Services add-on.
Syntax
DNS
::
len
DNS::len
Returns the dns packet message length
Note that when DNSSEC is used,
DNS::len
will contain the length of the reply before DNSSEC records are added to the reply.
Examples
Related Information
Valid Events:
DNS_REQUEST
,
DNS_RESPONSE
,
GLOBAL_GTM
